home.title: EdA Don Milani
home.subtitle: Adult Education Center
home.intro: The EdA Center (Adult Education) is a state school dedicated to education, instruction and training for adults. It offers literacy courses for foreigners (pre-A1, A1 and A2 levels) and advanced courses (B1 citizenship, B1, B2, C1 and C2); it also offers pathways to obtain a lower secondary school diploma and foreign language courses for adults. The EdA Center is also a CILS exam center in partnership with the University for Foreigners of Siena.

about.title: About us

testimonials.name: Shakila
testimonials.quote: When I arrived in Italy, I always said «Yes, yes», but I understood nothing. Now I can understand and speak, even with my doctor. She tells me: «Well done! You speak Italian well!»

testimonials.name: Abebech
testimonials.quote: Before I was afraid to write messages in Italian. Now I have learned to write better and I am no longer afraid. I can ask, speak, understand, I can reply. I want to keep studying.

testimonials.name: Gyste
testimonials.quote: Before I was stuck, I could not reply. Now the lady's daughter where I work says: «Now I understand you Gyste when you speak, well done!»

testimonials.name: Belvide
testimonials.quote: When I arrived in Italy I always said: «I don't speak Italian». But now it's better, I'm happy because I understand and can say what's inside me.

testimonials.name: Sabiqa and Sandra
testimonials.quote: Italian is really very difficult for me. It is very different from my language, but we don't give up and keep learning. I like learning together with others.

testimonials.name: Omayma and Marieta
testimonials.quote: Before everything was very difficult. Now I understand and can also write. I go to the doctor alone.

school.title: Our school
school.intro: At the EdA Center, lessons take place in the morning, afternoon and evening to accommodate students' work and family needs.
school.facilities: Our classrooms are spacious and bright, equipped with traditional boards and interactive whiteboards; we can use computer labs, a large auditorium and a welcoming entrance hall.
holidays: Monday 06/01/2026 and Tuesday 06/02/2026: Republic Day bridge

italianCourses.title: Italian courses
italianCourses.unistrapgNote: For more complete information, see the UNISTRASI website

courses.title: Literacy and basic Italian (pre-A1)
courses.description: For people who want to learn to read and write in Italian. 1.5–2 hours, 2–3 times per week, 120 hours total. Morning, afternoon or evening.

courses.title: A1 level pathway
courses.description: Certification for long-term residence permit. 2 hours twice a week, 100 hours total. Morning, afternoon or evening.

courses.title: A2 level pathway
courses.description: Certification for long-term residence permit. 1.5 hours twice a week, 80 hours total. Morning, afternoon or evening.

courses.title: B1 citizenship pathways
courses.description: Preparation for the Italian certification exam required for citizenship. 1.5 hours twice a week.

courses.title: B1, B2, C1 and C2 certification preparation
courses.description: Preparation for Italian certification exams at various levels. 1.5 hours twice a week.

courses.title: Preparatory pathway
courses.description: Preparation for middle school. 2 hours four times a week, 200 hours total.

courses.title: Lower secondary school diploma (middle school license)
courses.description: From October to May, aimed at obtaining the first cycle diploma. Monday to Thursday, 13 hours per week.

courses.title: Italian for driving license
courses.description: To understand the specific language used in theory courses. 1.5–2 hours per week.

languageCourses.title: Language courses
languageCourses.courseTitle: Foreign language courses: English, German, Spanish
languageCourses.description: These paid courses are activated only if a minimum number of enrollments is reached. Two 24-hour modules: October–January and February–May. Once a week, 2 hours, generally 7–9 PM. Levels A1, A2, B1 and B2.

exams.title: Exams
exams.levels: Levels B1 citizenship — B1 — B2 — C1 — C2
exams.description: CILS exam sessions are held throughout the year. Dates and registration periods are published on the home page.

ui.aboutLead: EdA سینٹر ایک سرکاری اسکول ہے جہاں بالغ اپنی رفتار اور مقصد کے ساتھ سیکھنے واپس آ سکتے ہیں۔
ui.aboutBody: یہاں تعلیم روزمرہ زندگی سے ملتی ہے۔ ہم ان لوگوں کے ساتھ کام کرتے ہیں جو اطالوی سیکھنا، پڑھائی دوبارہ شروع کرنا، سرٹیفکیٹ حاصل کرنا یا علاقے میں رہنمائی چاہتے ہیں۔

ui.contactsLead: لکھیں، کال کریں یا انٹرویو بک کریں: ہم مناسب راستہ تلاش کرنے میں مدد کریں گے۔
ui.startConversation: بات چیت سے شروع کرتے ہیں۔

accessibility.title: ایک سائٹ سب کے لیے۔
accessibility.lead: رسائی منصوبے کا حصہ ہے: واضح مواد، کی بورڈ استعمال اور ایسی تجربہ جو کسی کو باہر نہ رکھے۔
items: نیویگیشن، مرکزی مواد اور درجہ بند عنوانات کے ساتھ معنوی ساخت۔
مکمل کی بورڈ استعمال، بشمول «مرکزی مواد پر جائیں» کا لنک۔
واضح فوکس اشارے، مضبوط تضاد اور پڑھنے کے قابل متن۔
موافق لے آؤٹ، مناسب ٹچ علاقے اور کم حرکت کی حمایت۔
معلوماتی تصاویر کے متنی متبادل اور واضح لیبل والے فارم۔
accessibility.statement1: یہ منصوبہ WCAG 2.1 سطح AA اور EN 301 549 کے حوالے سے بنایا گیا۔ باضابطہ تصدیق کے بغیر مطابقت کا اعلان نہیں کیا جا سکتا۔
accessibility.statement2: عوامی انتظامیہ کی سائٹ کے لیے سرکاری بیان AgID پلیٹ فارم پر شائع ہونا چاہیے اور ہر سال اپ ڈیٹ ہونا چاہیے۔
accessibility.reportBody: اگر رسائی میں رکاوٹ ملے تو صفحہ، مسئلہ اور ممکنہ معاون ٹیکنالوجی کے ساتھ سیکرٹریٹ کو لکھیں۔
